review_notes:
I reviewed all 108 lines of the target file. I did not search the wider library. Candidate repetitions:
- `ofEq`: `continuous_toFun` and `continuous_invFun` are each `by subst h; exact continuous_id`. That is a one-line routine proof, so a helper would not pay off.
- The `IsTopologicalAddTorsor` instance for `s`: `continuous_vadd` and `continuous_vsub` both use `rw [Topology.IsEmbedding.subtypeVal.continuous_iff]; fun_prop`. This is a two-line identical script that relies on automation. It is too short to count as nontrivial repeated reasoning.
- `ContinuousAffineEquiv.affineSubspaceMap`: the forward and inverse continuity proofs have the same shape, `simpa [IsEmbedding.continuous_iff] using! (continuous.comp continuous_subtype_val).congr ...`. The pointwise equalities differ: the forward one is `rfl`, and the inverse one uses `eq_symm_apply` together with `affineSubspaceMap_apply_symm_apply`. A shared lemma would have to take the function, its continuity and the pointwise equation as hypotheses. That is essentially a restatement of `Continuous.congr` plus the embedding characterization, so it would be a thin wrapper and would not shorten the code. `isClosed_direction_iff` is a single proof with no duplicate block. No justified finding under this rubric.
